name: shoe-rack
description: A complete two-tier shoe rack with supporting posts and one whole shoe.
useCase: Identify shoe racks in entryway plans or furniture catalogues.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The full shoe has a raised heel and curved toe above the rack. Shorter posts expose the shoe silhouette, and a small upward shift balances it above the two shelves.

24.reason: The complete shoe upper curves into a rounded toe above the two shelves. The posts end at the upper shelf, and a small upward shift balances the whole rack.
